CustomField.description: When this row was last written by the receivables sync. FSD 4 requires the last-synced timestamp to be visible on screen, and no Property Management object carried one before this build. Naming follows the existing <Source>_Last_Synced_DateTime__c convention (Opportunity.CoStar_Last_Synced_DateTime__c, Property__c.Placer_Last_Synced_DateTime__c).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When this row was last refreshed from Yardi. If it looks old, the nightly sync may have halted - check the Sync Run.
CustomField.label: Yardi Last Synced
